jobs.prompt: Create ONE transparent-background raster asset for the Twin Pyramid Heads encounter from ORIGINAL Silent Hill 2 (2001), Lakeview Hotel final duo encounter. This is ONE collective roster profile represented by exactly TWO separate complete creatures in the same coherent image. Use the first two supplied native cutscene captures to identify the original sharply pointed rusty helmets, pale sleeveless stained long smocks, bare arms, dark boots and two long thin spears. The third supplied model render controls body/helmet/material only; do NOT copy its Great Knife or raised-leg pose. Compose a dedicated RIGHT-FACING LATERAL DUO: BOTH original Pyramid Heads face toward the right edge, with side-on head/torso/pelvis, in calm neutral standing poses. Place one a little ahead and one behind, slightly separated in depth so both helmets, four boots, four arms and each complete spear can be read without merging silhouettes. Each carries its OWN complete long narrow spear in a distinct natural neutral angle, with both full shafts, tips and butt ends visibly inside the frame. No Great Knife and no film/2024/Book of Memories helmet substitutions. Keep them recognizably two independent bodies in one composed encounter sprite, never a fused giant or one duplicated cutout. Both feet of each creature have a plausible shared support plane; no attack, impalement, victim, self-harm action or narrative ending. EXCLUDE the woman, cage and entire room from the reference. One duo only, no third actor, no scenery, floor, cast shadow, text, subtitles, HUD or multiple views. Detailed original-game-model-style raster, restrained diffuse light and native muted aged materials, no added blood or injury. True alpha transparency outside the two figures and through their separated limbs. Use a wide or square canvas as needed; keep the WHOLE duo and both weapons comfortably inside at least 8 percent clear margins on all four sides. This is a static lateral candidate, not a claim of source animation.

Create ONE isolated complete transparent-background raster of the One Truth / Giant Wall Man boss target from ORIGINAL Silent Hill 4: The Room (2004), based on the supplied native model render and commercial room screenshot. Represent exactly ONE of the established wall-mounted targets, with its own full bordering wall membrane and narrow supporting frame visible in the first reference, not the whole room or twelve copies. Create a dedicated RIGHT-FACING LATERAL VIEW: turn the front of the head and upper torso toward the right edge, while preserving their actual attachment to the vertical wall support behind them. A small angle is allowed to keep the FOUR source arms and the supporting border readable rather than hiding everything edge-on. Preserve the original elongated deformed head, compact dark torso emerging from the stretched ochre/rust-coloured wall surface, four long attached arms with complete hands, and the full tapered/trapezoidal wall-border silhouette from the native reference. The two thicker outer limbs and two thinner forward arms remain attached as in that model; do not add or remove a limb. The figure remains fixed to this upright support, with no human lower body, feet, walking stance, floor pedestal, wheels, invented rear machinery or free-standing humanoid form. Only the visible own wall border is included, not a newly invented full rail installation or surrounding architecture. Quiet static neutral pose, no attack, victim, new injury, blood, duplicated target, decal, text, HUD or multiple views. Complete head, all four hands and full existing support within generous at least 8 percent clear margins on all edges. Native detailed original-game-model-style raster, muted original colours, neutral diffuse light. Actual transparent alpha outside the attached wall-target assembly and through any existing open spaces. A single static target transposed for the current stationary versus presentation, not an animation of its rail and not the complete twelve-target puzzle.
